Container.Name: goatmediastackarr
Container.Overview: A whole media stack in one container: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, qBittorrent, SABnzbd, Jellyfin, Seerr, Tautulli and optionally Plex, already connected to each other, behind one interface and one login. Built-in VPN with a kill switch for the download apps (WireGuard or OpenVPN). Put your media in the Data share; everything else is set up on first start.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: GoatMediaStackarr web page

Config.Name: Jellyfin port
Config.Description: For Jellyfin apps on TVs and phones

Config.Name: Plex port
Config.Description: Only used if Plex is turned on (add plex to Apps to run)

Config.Name: Plex claim code
Config.Description: Only for built-in Plex: a code from https://plex.tv/claim links it to your Plex account. Codes last 4 minutes, so start the container right after. Not needed again once linked.

Config.Name: Seerr media server
Config.Description: Which media server Seerr uses when both Jellyfin and Plex run

Config.Name: Update Plex
Config.Description: Built-in Plex: get the newest public Plex at each start

Config.Name: Torrent port
Config.Description: Incoming torrent connections when the VPN is off. Not used with the VPN on.

Config.Name: Torrent port (UDP)
Config.Description: Same as above, UDP

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings and databases of every app, plus the vpn folder for your VPN file. Back this up.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your library: tv, movies and music folders are made inside it

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Torrent and usenet downloads

Config.Name: Media folder in container
Config.Description: Change only if you map one shared folder for both (for example /data/media), so downloads can be hardlinked instead of copied

Config.Name: Downloads folder in container
Config.Description: Change only if you map one shared folder for both (for example /data/downloads)

Config.Name: VPN on
Config.Description: true sends the download apps through your VPN with a kill switch

Config.Name: VPN type
Config.Description: wireguard: put the provider's .conf in App data/vpn. openvpn: put the .ovpn there.

Config.Name: VPN username
Config.Description: OpenVPN only, if your provider needs it

Config.Name: VPN password
Config.Description: OpenVPN only

Config.Name: Apps through VPN
Config.Description: Which apps use the VPN

Config.Name: VPN port forwarding
Config.Description: natpmp for ProtonVPN and other NAT-PMP providers: opens a port and gives it to qBittorrent

Config.Name: Port forwarding gateway
Config.Description: NAT-PMP gateway inside the tunnel (10.2.0.1 for ProtonVPN)

Config.Name: Apps to run
Config.Description: Remove any you do not want. Add plex for a built-in Plex server, tautulli for Plex statistics, and flaresolverr to get past Cloudflare checks on indexer sites (x86 only).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns files (99 is nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns files (100 is users on Unraid)

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For schedules and logs

Config.Name: Graphics card
Config.Description: Optional: /dev/dri for Intel/AMD hardware transcoding in Jellyfin
